# Fast Track School Supplies

> Fast Track School Supplies is an online service that takes the work out of back-to-school shopping. Parents upload their child's school supply list, the AI matches every item to the right product, and a packed kit ships to the door before the first bell. Pre-built grade-level kits and gift options for grandparents are also available.

## What we do

Fast Track School Supplies replaces the annual scramble of running from store to store for school supplies. We offer three ways to shop:

1. **Upload a supply list** — Parents drop a photo or PDF of the teacher's supply list. An AI assistant reads every line, matches each item to a SKU in our catalog, and builds a cart in seconds.
2. **Pre-built grade kits** — Eight curated kits, Kindergarten through High School, bundled at a 10% discount vs. buying items individually.
3. **Browse the store** — 50+ trusted school supplies (Ticonderoga pencils, Crayola crayons, Elmer's glue, etc.) with search, filters, and a custom cart.

## Subscriptions

Customers can subscribe to any product or whole kit for automatic refills every 1, 2, 3, or 6 months. Subscriptions get an automatic 10% discount.

## Shipping and returns

- Free shipping on orders over $35
- $5 flat shipping on orders under $35
- Ships within 1 business day of payment
- Standard transit: 3 to 7 business days within the continental US
- 30-day return window on unopened items, prepaid return label provided

## Gift a kit (grandparent feature)

Grandparents or any gift-giver can ship a pre-built kit directly to a grandchild's address. The site supports a personal handwritten-style note printed and tucked into the box.

## Who it's for

- Working parents who don't have time to comparison-shop 25 SKUs per kid
- Multi-child households needing different lists for different grades and schools
- Grandparents and family members who want to send a meaningful back-to-school gift
- Families who want to skip the chaos of August stores

## Differentiators

- **AI list matching** — no other school supply service reads the actual supply list and builds the cart for you.
- **Brand-accurate matches** — when a teacher specifies Ticonderoga or Crayola, we match the brand, not a generic substitute.
- **Subscribe & save** — recurring refills for items that run out mid-year (glue sticks, pencils, tissues).
- **Gift-ready packaging** — handwritten-style notes for grandparents and family.
